Sami: Heads-up — cutover in 45m. PR #6789 needs two reviewers per policy, currently only one. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6789
Caroline: On it, skimmed the diff — main nit is the toggle name. tiny change, can do a follow-up if you prefer. :thinking:
Ben: I can be the second reviewer if CI finishes and e2e pass. kicking off the job: `./ci/run-pr 6789`
deploy-bot: CI queued for PR #6789 — build 452 started, e2e in queue
Harper: Quick Q — any DB migrations or cache-affecting changes here? want to know if warm-up needed
Sami: No DB migration. cache warm-up script included in the PR (see last commit). perf run looked +0.8% latency at peak but within SLOs
Caroline: Pushed a one-line rename and removed an unused import. Marked ready for review. :rocket:
Ben: Left a tiny comment about log level, otherwise LGTM. :eyes:
Ben: approving now
Sami: Thanks @Ben — that's one approver. @Caroline are you able to approve after the rename CI passes?
Caroline: Approving after CI green. :white_check_mark:
Sami: Great — policy satisfied (2 reviewers). I'll merge at T-20 unless anyone objects. Cutover plan: canary 10% -> 50% @+10m -> full @+30m, with auto-fallback to previous model on error
Harper: Canary ok from infra side. I'll watch the latency + error-rate dashboards and be on standby
Sami: Merging in 2 minutes
deploy-bot: Merge completed. Deploy to canary started. sha: `a1b2c3d` :shipit:
Sami: Nice work all. Keep an eye on infra/canary and ping #eng-sre immediately if anything spikes. :pray:
